headline: India and European Union Target December Deadline to Finalise Trade Agreement
summary: Negotiators from India and the European Union are working to finalize a free trade agreement ahead of a planned mid-December summit in Brussels during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's European visit.
why: The European Union and India represent two of the world's largest consumer and manufacturing markets. An FTA would lower tariffs on industrial goods, agricultural products, and services, enhancing bilateral trade flows.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Finalizing a comprehensive trade agreement with the EU provides expanded market access for Indian exporters.
